name: Hampstead Heath Sloe Bushes
short_description: Sloe berries on the Heath edges.
description: Abundant blackthorn bushes around the perimeter and woodland edges of Hampstead Heath yield a fine crop of sloe berries perfect for autumn sloe gin.
